answer.summary: The only failure is the deterministic ArchUnit rule TenantActiveTableAccessArchTest.parameters_platform_row_writers_run_under_platform_write (1 of 1456 tests). The PR's new code in XtmComposerService.refreshConnectivity reaches PlatformSettingsService writes (resolve, saveSetting, saveSettings) without the platform-write marker, and the rule says such writes are refused on the dual-scope parameters table. The rule ran clean in the same job at 3041-3042 and 3074, and the flagged classes are in the touched file list, so a rerun will fail the same way. Fix by putting the writes under the platform-write marker or moving them out of that call path.
